title: Veterinary Doctor Training Manual
short_description: Start here for the complete doctor learning path, training schedule, workflows, handoffs, exercises, and readiness checklist.

title: Doctor Daily Workflow
short_description: Learn the daily clinic routine: review appointments, open patient records, respond to alerts, complete care, and hand off safely.

title: Patient Medical Record Workflow
short_description: Learn how to find the correct patient, confirm the Pet Owner, review history, and avoid duplicate patient records.

title: Veterinary Masters Awareness
short_description: Understand master records doctors select in forms and when to ask Admin or Branch Manager to update missing or duplicate values.

title: Consultation Workflow
short_description: Learn how to review a patient, record clinical findings, request lab/vaccination actions, understand payment gate messages, and complete a consultation safely.

title: Lab Order Workflow
short_description: Learn how to request diagnostic tests, understand lab handoffs, review results, and update the care plan.

title: Vaccination and Preventive Care Workflow
short_description: Learn how to review vaccination history, record preventive care, handle payment-before-administration messages, and plan follow-up.

title: Hospitalisation Workflow
short_description: Learn how to manage Hospitalisation from admission through inpatient activities, charge/stock handoffs, readiness checks, and discharge.

title: Grooming Service Handoff
short_description: Learn when grooming remains a non-clinical service handoff and when a grooming concern should become a consultation.

title: Boarding Service Handoff
short_description: Learn how doctors support boarding through medical clearance, vaccination review, owner instructions, and escalation to consultation or Hospitalisation.

title: Notifications and Action Centre Workflow
short_description: Learn how to read, acknowledge, complete, dismiss, and archive Veterinary notifications without losing clinical handoffs.

title: Reports and Dashboards Workflow
short_description: Learn how to use doctor-accessible reports and dashboards to find work, apply filters, and return to the source record.

title: Role Access Matrix
short_description: Review doctor access boundaries, supporting roles, role verification notes, and common team handoffs.

title: Troubleshooting and Common Errors
short_description: Learn safe responses to common permission, branch, payment, stock, workflow, grooming, boarding, and master-value messages.

title: Glossary
short_description: Review common VetEdge and Veterinary terms used across doctor training modules.

title: Screenshot Manifest
short_description: Review screenshot placeholders, capture instructions, and pending/captured status for future training assets.

title: Veterinary Home and EdgeSuite Daily Start
short_description: Start from the role-aware Veterinary Home, verify branch context, use authoritative drill-downs and work consistently in Light or Dark appearance.
video_title: Veterinary Home and EdgeSuite Daily Start

title: Medical History Completion and Clinical Truth
short_description: Understand how consultations, structured vitals, completed laboratory orders, administered vaccinations, hospitalisation and billing gates affect Medical History.
video_title: Medical History Completion and Clinical Truth

title: Safe Workflow Handoffs and Submitted-Document Control
short_description: Transfer incomplete work with complete evidence and preserve clinical, stock, branch, permission and ERPNext accounting controls.

title: Owner and Administrator Operations
short_description: Govern Veterinary Settings, masters, pricing, ERPNext stock and finance, Billing Center, dashboards, VCN/NADIS reporting and management controls.

title: Branch Manager Operations
short_description: Run daily and weekly branch control across queues, billing, stock, hospitalisation, services, reports and assigned exceptions.

title: Veterinary Nursing Operations
short_description: Record structured observations and assigned inpatient activities while preserving patient identity and practitioner authority.

title: Front Desk Operations and Billing Center
short_description: Manage owners, patients, appointments, queues and Billing Center handoffs without changing clinical or submitted accounting records.
video_title: Front Desk Operations and Billing Center

title: Accounts, Cashier and Billing Operations
short_description: Trace Billing Sessions into Sales Invoices and Payment Entries, allocate collections and correct submitted-document errors safely.

title: Dispensary and Stock Operations
short_description: Issue treatment stock by Warehouse and Batch, enforce FEFO and expiry, transfer stock and reconcile inventory safely.

title: Laboratory Operations
short_description: Progress Lab Orders through sample handling, result entry, review and completion while excluding unfinished work from Medical History.

title: Grooming Operations
short_description: Progress grooming work, document service evidence and escalate medical stop conditions into the clinical workflow.

title: Boarding Operations
short_description: Coordinate boarding bookings, kennel capacity, care records, owner instructions, billing handoffs and clinical escalation.
